title: Set default growth rates for each type of account
summary: Accounts grow at inflation by default. Change one account at a time, or set a default rate for each category in Assumptions.

chapters.label: By default, every account just grows at inflation, 2.40% a year.
A new account starts on Plan default, which means inflation.
To change it, go account by account: open one and pick a rate.
Or set one default for each category, in the plan's Assumptions.
Every account on Plan default follows its category's rate.
Modeling them in an 80/20 mix? Set Taxable to Growth (80/20).
Do the same for Retirement. Changes save as you go.
Or type your own rate. Cash gets 3% a year.
Back on Net Worth, the warning is gone.
Every account in those categories now grows at the 80/20 rate.

steps: **See the default.** A new account's **Growth Rate** starts on **Plan default**, and on a new plan that's the inflation rate. **Net Worth** shows a warning while taxable or retirement accounts still grow at inflation.
**Change one account.** On **Net Worth**, open an account. Its **Growth Rate** offers your firm's model portfolios, the inflation rate and **Custom %**. Pick one and save.

**Or set a default for each category.** Go to **Assumptions** and open **Growth & Inflation**. The **Default Growth Rates** table has one row per category. You can also select **Set growth rates** in the warning.
**Choose a source for each category.** In the **Source** column, pick a model portfolio, for example **Growth (80/20)**, for **Taxable** and **Retirement**. Changes save automatically.
**Or enter your own rate.** Choose **Custom %** and type a rate in the **Rate** column.
**Check the accounts.** Back on **Net Worth**, the warning is gone and every account on **Plan default** shows its category's new rate.
goodToKnow: An account with its own growth rate keeps it. To put every taxable, cash and retirement account back on its category default, select **Reset all accounts to defaults** below the table. It clears account-level rates and portfolios, and works on the base plan only.
Real Estate, Business and Life Insurance grow at inflation or a custom rate.
Plan Confidence varies returns year to year only for accounts on a model portfolio or asset mix. An inflation or custom rate grows the same every year.
